{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonic whistle''' was a device that when blown into would produce a considerably loud noise.

==History==
[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] at the elite [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] would typically use sonic whistles to awaken [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] during reveille. The cadet [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] personally found the whistle's produced sound to be a harsh method to be waken up by, and quickly trained himself to rise a half hour before his sergeant used the device each morning.
